notes.claim: A basis is a set of independent arrows that span the space, and any numbers describing an arrow depend on the basis chosen.

sources.title: Linear combinations, span, and basis vectors | 3Blue1Brown
sources.quote: The technical definition for the "basis" of a space is a set of linearly independent vectors that span that space

sources.title: Linear combinations, span, and basis vectors | 3Blue1Brown
sources.quote: Together they are called the "basis" of the coordinate system. What this means is that when you think about coordinates as scalars, the basis vectors are what those scalars actually scale
